summary: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd, a NASDAQ-listed PRC household appliance maker, furnished a routine Form 6-K covering the month of September 2026, filed September 30, 2026. The submission contains only unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 as Exhibit 99.1, plus inline XBRL exhibits, and is incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanic is disclosed. This is an ordinary interim-reporting filing with no event-driven risk-arb angle; the next catalyst is operational results disclosure.
